name: CoffeeShop
source:
A love story about a university student and his rival, that get to know each other throughout days of running into each other, hardships, and drinking hot chocolate at a coffee shop.

[From [url=https://ivetten.itch.io/coffeshopbetademo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一则关于大学生与他的对手的爱情故事。两人在一次次偶遇、共同经历的困境，以及在咖啡馆喝热巧克力的时光中，逐渐了解彼此。

[摘自[url=https://ivetten.itch.io/coffeshopbetademo]itch.io[/url]]
